/*
 * The game's shared stylesheet (D-421): the base rules, the one :focus-visible rule, the header with
 * the menu bar and the menu „Konto”, the rows of sentences, the place of the screens and their common
 * layout, the shared controls with the icon mask and the forms, and the rules of what the kitchen-sink
 * page draws besides the controls. It holds also the rules of the screens that have no stylesheet of
 * their own yet: Siedziba with its camp, Postać, Mapy, Wiedza, the list of accounts and the login
 * card. It reads each value of appearance from the design tokens of tokens.css by var(--…)
 * (guidelines/styleguide-browser-view.md). Layout values D-43 leaves out stand here: line-height, the
 * @media threshold, widths and heights, and the sizes of the columns of the layout grid.
 */
R:
/*
 * The stylesheet of the screen Przejście (D-421): the grid of its areas, the area under the drawing
 * with the tabs and the chronicle, its header with the bar of the solving condition, the band of a
 * discovery, the question „Zapisać, odrzucić, wrócić?”, the end-of-run window, the rows „Teraz” and
 * „Potem”, the row of the body, and the world area with the scene: its layers, effects, frost, motion
 * and keyframes. The page links it after styles.css, and it reads each value of appearance from the
 * design tokens of tokens.css by var(--…).
 */
